    select
        case 
            when ph1_0.referrer like '%google%' escape '' 
                then 'Google' 
            when ph1_0.referrer like '%facebook%' escape '' 
                then 'Facebook' 
            when ph1_0.referrer like '%twitter%' escape '' 
            or ph1_0.referrer like '%x.com%' escape '' 
                then 'Twitter/X' 
            when ph1_0.referrer like '%telegram%' escape '' 
                then 'Telegram' 
            when ph1_0.referrer is null 
            or ph1_0.referrer='' 
                then 'Direct' 
            else 'Other' 
    end,
    count(ph1_0.hit_id) 
from
    page_hits ph1_0

    ph1_0.created_at>=?
